title: The Golden Age
no_3d: This browser cannot draw the district in 3D (WebGPU is not available here). The plan below is the whole game: everything can be done from it.
board_label: The district in 3D. The arrow keys move the plot cursor and Enter uses the tool in hand; with the canal tool, Shift and an arrow dig a link. W, A, S, D move the view, Q and E turn it, R and F zoom. Everything can also be done in the plan view.
goal_welfare: Welfare at {goal} or more, seasons running: {steady} of {n}
advice_debt: The treasury is in debt. Seasons in debt: {n} of {max}. At {max} the district is lost.
advice_unrest: The people are close to leaving. Seasons of unrest: {n} of {max}. At {max} the district is lost.
advice_debt_coming: This season will end in debt. Raise the tax, or clear a building you cannot keep up.
advice_hunger: There is not enough grain: {percent}% of households will go hungry this season. Farms need water, and hands to work them.
advice_thirst: There is not enough drinking water for the houses on the canal. The canal can carry only so much.
advice_silt: Silt is choking the canals: they run at {percent}%. Clearing it restores the flow.
advice_first_canal: Houses without water in reach: {n}. Choose the canal tool and dig a link toward them.
advice_farm_water: The farms are getting {percent}% of the water they need. Drinking comes first; farms take what is left.
advice_dry_houses: Houses without water in reach: {n}. A canal beside them raises welfare.
advice_market: There is no market. One within three streets of the houses brings trade into the treasury.
advice_housing: Every house is full. Nobody new can settle until more houses are built.
advice_labour: There are not enough hands: every workplace runs at {percent}%. More households would help, or fewer workplaces.
advice_school: There is no school. Schools earn the learning that research needs.
advice_research: Learning is waiting to be used. Choose a project under Research.
advice_welfare: Welfare is heading for {target}; the goal is {goal}. The ledger shows what is holding it down.
advice_idle: Some households have no work, which lowers welfare. A workplace would employ them.
advice_workshop: A workshop with water, within four streets of a market, gives the market goods to sell.
advice_steady: The district is steady. Keep it so, and build toward the goal.
effect_drought: The intake carries two fifths less water.
effect_good-harvest: Farms bring in about a third more.
effect_caravan: Markets trade half as much again.
effect_silting: The canals lose about an eighth of their flow until the silt is cleared.
effect_fever: Welfare falls; less where baths or a hospital are in reach.
tax_note: Coins per ten households: {coins}. Cost to welfare: {welfare}.
canal_condition: The canals run at {percent}% of their flow.
ledger_none: No season has been played yet.
ledger_water: The canal carries {supply}; the district needs {need}.
ledger_sold: No room to store {n}: sold for {coins} coins
ledger_welfare_target: Welfare is heading for {n}, and moves a third of the way each season. What makes that figure:
research_note: Schools earn learning, and a project takes it as it comes. There is not enough for every project, so choose.
research_effect_lined-canals: Stone-lined channels lose less to silt: the canals keep 25 points more of their full flow.
research_effect_crop-rotation: Fields rested in turn yield three tenths more.
research_effect_paper: Books can be copied: the library can be built.
research_effect_water-wheel: A wheel at the intake lifts half as much water again.
desc_inspect: Point at a plot to read what it holds and what reaches it.
desc_canal: A link joins two neighbouring crossings. It must start at the river bank or at a canal already dug. Water serves the plot it passes and the four beside it.
desc_demolish: Clears a building. A quarter of its cost comes back.
desc_house: Room for 20 households; for 32 with water and a bath in reach.
desc_farm: Feeds the district. Without water in reach it grows a quarter of a crop. Full harvests are in spring and autumn.
desc_market: Brings trade from the houses within three streets, up to 60 households.
desc_workshop: With water, gives markets within four streets goods to sell.
desc_school: Earns learning from the houses within three streets, and raises their welfare.
desc_bath: Needs water. Raises welfare within two streets, and lets watered houses hold more.
desc_granary: Stores far more grain, and far less of it spoils.
desc_library: Schools earn nearly half as much learning again. A second library adds as much; a third adds nothing.
desc_hospital: Raises welfare within four streets and blunts a fever.
reason_occupied: This plot is already built on.
reason_empty: There is nothing here to clear.
reason_not-researched: This has not been researched yet.
reason_no-funds: The treasury cannot pay for this.
reason_not-adjacent: A link joins two neighbouring plots.
reason_not-connected: A canal must start at the river bank or at a canal already dug.
tip_reach: Houses in reach from here: {n} of {total}
info_house_more: With water and a bath in reach it would hold {n}.
info_farm_watered: Watered: it grows a full crop in season.
info_farm_dry: Dry: it grows a quarter of a crop.
info_market_reach: Houses in reach: {n} of {total}. It can serve {capacity} households.
info_market_goods: A workshop supplies it with goods.
info_market_no_goods: No working workshop within four streets.
info_granary: Holds 160 more grain; stored grain spoils a quarter as fast.
restart_confirm: Start again? The game in hand will be replaced.
toast_canal: Canal dug. Plots with water in reach: {n}.
saved_note: The game is kept on this device only.
save_newer: A game saved by a newer version was found and left untouched. This game will not be saved.
save_unreadable: The saved game could not be read. It has been set aside, and a new game started.
outcome_won_text: Its people stayed, its schools taught and its treasury held, for a full year without faltering.
outcome_lost-insolvent_text: Three seasons in debt, and the district could no longer pay its way. The ledger shows where the coin went.
outcome_lost-unrest_text: Three seasons of hardship, and the households moved away. The ledger shows what was missing.
outcome_ended_text: The district stands, but it did not reach every goal.
score_line: Balance: {score} of 1000. It compares two games on the same district; it is not a ranking.
help_1: You are steward of a district on a river. Each turn is a season: build, dig, set the tax, choose research, then end the season.
help_2: Water is the heart of it. A canal link joins two crossings and must start at the river or at a canal. A plot is watered if a canal passes it or passes beside it.
help_3: The canal carries only so much. Drinking comes first, then farms, then workshops and baths. Summer needs more; drought brings less.
help_4: Where you build matters. Markets, schools, baths and hospitals serve only the houses within a few streets. Every building needs workers.
help_5: The figures in the top bar show, beside each stock, what this season will do to it. The ledger gives the reasons.
help_6: You lose after three seasons in a row in debt or in unrest, and the count is always shown. An event is always announced a season before it begins.
help_7: The city is fictional. Costs, yields and prices are game numbers, not historical figures.
help_controls: Mouse: click to use the tool in hand, drag to move the view, right-drag to turn it, scroll to zoom. Keys: 1 to 9 and 0 choose a building, C the canal, X clear, I look, U undo, M the plan, O the whole district.
plan_note: North is up; the river is at the bottom. Every plot and every canal link is a button.
